title: routers/users.py — SUPERVISOR-only user CRUD (5 endpoints)
scope_amendment_note: PO-authorized bounded scope amendment (2026-07-05) per Option A of critique_T-073.json. auth_service.py added to output_files[] solely to introduce AuthService.get_user (read-only, no commit) and AuthService.deactivate_user (BaseRepository.soft_delete per DS-008). No other AuthService methods may be modified in this scope. LLD amended in the same commit — sprints/V2/design/lld.json now declares 5 endpoints on users.py and 7 methods on AuthService.
scope: FastAPI router with prefix='/users', tags=['users']. 5 endpoints, all protected by require_supervisor: GET '' (list active users via svc.list_users()); POST '' 201 (create user via svc.create_user(payload)); GET '/{user_id}' (get by ID via svc.get_user(user_id)); PATCH '/{user_id}' (partial update via svc.update_user(user_id, payload)); DELETE '/{user_id}' 204 no-body (soft-deactivate via svc.deactivate_user(user_id), DS-008). Also adds two AuthService methods: get_user(user_id) -> UserModel (read-only, self._repo.get(user_id)); deactivate_user(user_id) -> UserModel (self._repo.soft_delete(user_id); self._db.commit()).
